text:
liam: FYI support ticket from Safebridge — customer reporting p95 spikes since ~10:20 UTC in eu-west-2 dedicated pool. They say some requests that were ~1s are now 3-4s. Ticket: https://redwood.support/INC-41289

ana: thanks. severity? SLA risk? which model / route are they on?

maya: assigning triage. can someone pull p95 traces + routing for that customer and paste a short summary here? tagging @raj for runtime logs.

raj: quick check — their traffic is hitting hummingbird-3b:quant-8bit-v2 (rolled yesterday at 09:50 UTC to 100% for eu-west-2). Observed: sharp drop in KV cache hit rate and concurrent batch_wait_ms jump. snippet: ```2026-03-20T10:22:10Z [route=safebridge] KV_CACHE_MISS: 1520 -> 9480; batch_wait_ms.p95: 22 -> 210; model_fallback_count: 4 -> 380```

tess: infra metrics also show scheduler queue length spike on the dedicated pool around 10:21 — some GPUs briefly reported high GPU memory pressure and one pod OOM-killed at 10:24, which triggered extra routing to fallback instances (CPU-backed) for a subset of requests.

liam: customer reported degraded UX on their live checkout flow; they sent a sample request id: req_0b3f7a2e. They say latency visible to users started ~10:23 and is persistent.

raj: theory: quant-8bit-v2 changed memory layout + KV prefetch behavior; combined with a small mem pressure event caused more KV cache misses and increased batching time (waiting for larger batches to amortize increased per-infer overhead). Plan: immediate mitigation -> route Safebridge to quant-8bit-v1 (previous baseline) while we investigate. Command to pin route: ```redwood route update --customer safebridge --route default --model hummingbird-3b:quant-8bit-v1 --reason "p95 regression rollback"```

ana: good. what's the rollback / communication criteria? if p95 drops back to baseline within 10 minutes, we tell customer we rolled back and continue investigation; otherwise we escalate to infra and consider capacity bump. please confirm expected impact window.

maya: I'll run the route update now and monitor. creating internal rollout ticket #RR-4567. @deploy-bot can you start the rollback job? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Started job RR-4567: rolling safebridge route back to hummingbird-3b:quant-8bit-v1. Job id=job-4567. Expected propagation 2-4m.

tess: after rollback completes we should collect: 1) end-to-end traces for sample req_0b3f7a2e, 2) KV cache hit-rate by shard, 3) pod eviction logs and GPU mem stats. Action owner: raj (runtime) + tess (sre). Also add a follow-up to product for rollout gating criteria (ana).

raj: noted. I'll post a short post-rollback snapshot in ~5m with p95 numbers and KV metrics.

liam: looping Safebridge contact in thread and telling them we're doing a rollback and monitoring; will update in 10.

maya: live monitor: p95 for safebridge route dropped from 3.8s -> 1.1s within 3m of job start. marking triage as mitigated. keeping ticket open for RCA. :white_check_mark:
